bullets.text: Spring Statement 2026 Insights - The Chancellor's low-key statement signals significant upcoming changes for small businesses in the UK.
MTD: A Game Changer - Making Tax Digital for Income Tax transforms tax compliance into a daily routine for small businesses.
Emotional Labour Risks - Accountants face increased emotional strain as clients adapt to Making Tax Digital changes.
AI for Small Businesses - Streamlining one repetitive task with AI can significantly reduce admin time and improve efficiency.
Understanding MTD Penalties - New penalty systems for Making Tax Digital aim to encourage timely submissions and compliance.
Embedded Accounting Growth - Financial institutions are prioritising embedded accounting to enhance customer experience and retention.
Preparing Landlords for MTD - Accountants must educate landlord clients about upcoming MTD requirements and compliance.
